Prism Headline Round is a renamed, character-subset webfont derived from
ChillRoundF v3.0 by ChillType. No glyph outlines were changed.
Source: https://github.com/Warren2060/ChillRound/blob/main/ChillRoundF%20v3.0.ttf
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see chillround-OFL.txt.
This derivative remains under that license and does not use the reserved font names.
The subset contains only the PRISM homepage headline characters.
